semantic_notes: cik is the ten-digit SEC filer identifier, not a domestic incorporation number. The legacy normalized registration_number field carries this provider identifier only.
name is the current filer name from SEC submissions metadata.
This mapping extracts identity only. It makes no claim about incorporation jurisdiction, legal status, full filing-history coverage or financial coverage.
For the current Java bridge use registry SEC EDGAR filer directory, registryJurisdiction US, registrationKind unknown. Do not label these records domestic incorporation registrations.
